lead.event: Rupiah reaches successive record lows in November 2026
lead.headline: Rupiah sets another November record low at Rp18,270 per US dollar
lead.blurb: The rupiah hit an intraday record of Rp18,270 per US dollar and closed at Rp18,258 on 16 November, down 0.35%. Its previous record was Rp18,239 on 12 November, after a 13 November close of Rp18,206. The currency had depreciated 2.9% since 16 September and 8.51% year to date amid a strong US dollar, elevated US yields and domestic risk concerns. Bank Indonesia’s Board of Governors meets on 17–18 November.

other.event: ULTJ sets cum date for additional Rp100 per share dividend
other.headline: ULTJ sets 16 November cum date for additional Rp100-per-share dividend
other.blurb: Ultrajaya’s additional Rp1 trillion cash dividend for fiscal 2025 was approved at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 6 November. It will be funded from unrestricted retained earnings, which stood at Rp7.5 trillion at year-end 2025; the company previously paid a final dividend of Rp130 per share on 22 May.

deals_control.event: IDEA shareholders approve Nawasena's acquisition of a 66.58% stake
deals_control.headline: IDEA shareholders approve Nawasena’s acquisition of a 66.58% stake
deals_control.blurb: Idea Indonesia shareholders approved the transfer of 707.32 million shares to Nawasena, valued at about Rp38 billion at Rp53.73 per share. The meeting also appointed Yukki Nugrahawan Hanafi as president commissioner and Otto Ardianto as president director.

deals_control.event: BUMI postpones the targeted completion of its Laman Mining acquisition
deals_control.headline: BUMI postpones Laman acquisition completion target to 31 January 2027
deals_control.blurb: Bumi agreed with seller Supreme Global Investment to extend the long-stop date from 30 October after preliminary transaction requirements remained unmet. It has allocated Rp333.6 billion from bond proceeds and says the delay has no material negative impact on its operations, financial condition or business continuity.

deals_control.event: COIN agrees to acquire 10% of MIG for Rp200 billion
deals_control.headline: COIN agrees to acquire 10% of MIG for Rp200 billion
deals_control.blurb: Indokripto Koin Semesta reported a nine-month 2026 net loss of Rp59.11 billion, versus a Rp41.08 billion profit a year earlier. It signed a conditional agreement on 13 November to subscribe for 1,223,435 new Series B shares in MIG for about Rp200 billion, giving it 10% upon completion. No completion schedule was disclosed.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: COIN reported a nine-month net loss of Rp59.11 billion, versus a Rp41.08 billion profit a year earlier.

deals_control.event: HRME settles dispute over The Hermitage Jakarta hotel auction
deals_control.headline: HRME settles Hermitage hotel auction dispute after Rp489.58 billion asset transfer
deals_control.blurb: Menteng Heritage Realty says auction winner Hotel Menteng Jakarta took over the hotel and land, with a net book value of Rp489.58 billion, or 60% of assets on 30 September 2026. The transfer offset Rp205.35 billion owed to Bank Mandiri, leaving no bank debt, though the company still bears the loss and is reviewing strategic alternatives.

market_structure_policy.event: Prabowo calls for the state to receive at least 70% of mining profits
market_structure_policy.headline: Prabowo calls for state to get at least 70% of mining profits
market_structure_policy.blurb: It remains unclear whether existing taxes and royalties would count toward the proposed 70% state share of mining benefits. Prabowo also raised possible state ownership in mining companies and called for all mining exports to pass through one channel. Mining stocks broadly fell on 16 November.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: It remained unclear whether existing taxes and royalties would count toward the proposed 70% state share of mining benefits.

market_structure_policy.event: FTSE Russell removes 14 Indonesian stocks from its global indexes
market_structure_policy.headline: FTSE Russell removes 14 Indonesian stocks from global indexes
market_structure_policy.blurb: The deletions include BRIS from Large Cap, MTEL and TBIG from Mid Cap, MAPI and TKIM from Small Cap, and nine stocks from Micro Cap. FTSE Russell postponed new additions through the March 2027 review and free-float increases until at least that review. Changes take effect 21 December.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI removes EMTK from its Small Cap Index
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI removes EMTK from Small Cap Index effective 30 November
market_structure_policy.blurb: Emtek is one of seven constituents removed, with the change taking effect at market close. In Q3 2026, revenue rose 15.77% to Rp15.93 trillion, but a Rp2.89 trillion investment loss contributed to a Rp256.16 billion net loss attributable to parent owners.

market_structure_policy.event: ERAA joins the IDX LQ45 index
market_structure_policy.headline: ERAA joins LQ45 with an index weight of about 0.25%
market_structure_policy.blurb: Erajaya's inclusion is effective from 18 November to 29 January 2027. Phintraco Sekuritas analyst Alrich Paskalis Tambolang says it may increase exposure to institutional investors and benchmark-tracking fund managers, but expects limited passive inflows and sees the inclusion as an additional rather than primary price catalyst.

earnings_guidance.event: ASII announces 2030 targets and capital-reallocation strategy at Investor Day
earnings_guidance.headline: ASII sets 2030 goals and targets Rp10 trillion asset reallocation
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astra targets EPS of Rp1,150–Rp1,200, excluding non-recurring items, and minimum return on equity of 15%, while redirecting around Rp10 trillion in net assets by 2030 to businesses with better return prospects. It maintains a 45%–50% dividend payout policy and targets annual total shareholder returns in the low teens.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Astra maintains a 45%–50% dividend payout policy and targets annual total shareholder returns in the low teens.

earnings_guidance.event: Antam reports nine-month 2026 net profit up 46% to Rp9.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports nine-month net profit up 46% to Rp9.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Antam's revenue rose 23% to Rp88.48 trillion, with precious metals and refining contributing Rp68.8 trillion, about 78% of the total. Gold sales reached 25.2 tons worth Rp68.4 trillion, up 17%.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset raises its target price and profit forecasts for Indo Tambangraya Megah
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset raises ITMG target price to Rp26,520 and profit forecasts
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas lifted its target from Rp25,000, implying 8.9% upside, and kept a hold recommendation on Indo Tambangraya Megah. It raised its net profit projections by 15.6% for 2026 and 5.9% for 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: OJK reports nine-month multifinance industry net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: OJK reports nine-month multifinance profit up 22.8% to Rp19.82 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: BFI Finance posted net profit of Rp1.31 trillion, up 11.96% year on year, while Adira Finance earned Rp1.69 trillion, up 55.04%, through September 2026. Industry outstanding financing rose 2.21% to Rp518.34 trillion, and gross non-performing financing improved to 2.98% from 3.04% in August.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ANDA plans IPO to raise up to Rp316.76 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ANDA plans IPO to raise up to Rp316.76 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Andalan Artha Primanusa is offering up to 1.67 billion new shares, equal to 25.1% of its fully paid-up capital, at Rp 158-189 per share. It plans to allocate 65% of proceeds to working capital and around Rp107 billion to debt repayment. The offering runs through 17 November, with a potential listing on 1 December.
